Front:
In a multi-company setup, how can you allow a customer record to be shared across all companies?

A) This is not possible because each customer is restricted to a single company.
B) Leave the "Company" field empty on the contact record (Sales & Purchase Tab).
C) Enable an option called Accessible to Everyone on the contact.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Leave the "Company" field empty on the contact record (Sales & Purchase Tab).

Front:
Why can you sort by some fields in a list view but not by others?

A) You can only sort simple fields, not relational fields.
B) You can only sort fields that are not computed.
C) You can only sort fields stored in the database.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) You can only sort fields stored in the database.

Front:
What is the difference between a message/discussion and a log note in the chatter?

A) A message/discussion is sent to the customer and notifies all followers, while a log note is only visible internally or via @mentions.
B) A message/discussion is posted publicly on the record, while a log note is meant for internal updates or team collaboration.
C) A message/discussion sends notifications to external contacts, while a log note keeps communication limited to internal followers.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) A message/discussion sends notifications to external contacts, while a log note keeps communication limited to internal followers.

Front:
What action(s) need to be taken on the Odoo dashboard to order the placement of the icons?

A) Enable edit mode from the dashboard settings, then use the "Arrange Apps" option to drag icons into place.
B) Open the user menu, select "Customize Dashboard," and reorder the apps by dragging them in the list view.
C) Click on an app icon and hold the mouse button down; the icon will tilt slightly, allowing it to be dragged into a new position within the app grid.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Click on an app icon and hold the mouse button down; the icon will tilt slightly, allowing it to be dragged into a new position within the app grid.

Front:
How can you bulk add or remove followers from multiple records in Odoo?

A) In List View, select the records, click Actions, then choose Add/Remove Followers.
B) In Form View, open each record and manage followers individually under the chatter.
C) From Settings > Users & Companies, update the follower lists for all related records.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) In List View, select the records, click Actions, then choose Add/Remove Followers.

Front:
What happens to the fields of secondary contacts when merging into a master contact?

A) Odoo discards all information from secondary contacts except for linked records.
B) Fields in the master record remain, and non-empty fields from the secondary records are merged in.
C) All fields from secondary contacts overwrite the data in the master contact.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Fields in the master record remain, and non-empty fields from the secondary records are merged in.

Front:
A customer buys a sweater under a pricelist that includes a 10% discount, rounds to the nearest $1.00, and has a -0.10 extra fee. If the sweater's sale price is $99, what is the final cost for this product after applying the pricelist's rules?

A) $89.10
B) $88.90
C) $89.99
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) $88.90

Front:
Where can you see the profit margin for a given sales order?

A) Margins are only calculated for all of the orders in each quarter
B) Margins for a sales order can be found on the sales order itself, so long as the "Margins" checkbox has been ticked in the Sales app settings
C) Margins can only be viewed by going to the Reporting header and clicking "Margins"
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Margins for a sales order can be found on the sales order itself, so long as the "Margins" checkbox has been ticked in the Sales app settings

Front:
How do you view Margins in the Sales Analysis dashboard?

A) Margins are visible by default in this dashboard
B) Clear all existing filters and search for "Margin"
C) Click the "Measures" drop-down menu and select "Margin"
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Click the "Measures" drop-down menu and select "Margin"

Front:
What condition must be true when using a default unit of measure and purchase unit of measure?

A) The two units of measure must share the same reference unit
B) The two units of measure cannot share the same reference unit
C) The two units of measure must have the same unit name as each other
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The two units of measure must share the same reference unit

Front:
Regarding pricelists and the unit price of a product in a quotation, which of the following is true?

A) For a product with a pricelist, that price will override the Sales Price on the product's form
B) Whenever you change the associated pricelist on a quotation, the product's unit price is automatically recomputed
C) Both are true
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) For a product with a pricelist, that price will override the Sales Price on the product's form

Front:
How could you prevent a specific product from being used in quotations?

A) By archiving the product
B) By setting a blocking warning on the product ('Sale Warnings' setting must be activated)
C) Both solutions are correct
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Both solutions are correct

Front:
What's the best way to set up the product form for a product where a consultant will come to the customer's location and conduct a home appraisal?

A) This should be set up with the Product Type "Goods" and the Invoicing Policy "Delivered quantities", since the consultant is delivering themself by coming to the customer
B) This should be set up with the Product Type "Service" and the Invoicing Policy "Prepaid/Fixed Price" since the consultant is providing a one-time service
C) This should be set up with the Product Type "Combo", since the appraisal is a service but coming to the customer's location counts as a delivered good
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) This should be set up with the Product Type "Service" and the Invoicing Policy "Prepaid/Fixed Price" since the consultant is providing a one-time service

Front:
How would you configure a promotion to offer the following: 'Receive a free tote bag with your purchase of $50 or more'?

A) Create a Conditional Rule with the minimum quantity set to '50' and create a Reward with Reward Type set to 'Discount.' Then, enter 'Free Tote Bag' in the Description On Order field
B) Create a Conditional Rule with the minimum purchase set to '50' and create a Reward with a Reward Type set to 'Free Shipping.' Then enter 'Free Tote Bag' in the Description On Order field
C) Create a Conditional Rule with the minimum purchase set to '50' and create a Reward with Reward Type set to 'Free Product.' Then, create or select 'Tote Bag' in the Product field
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Create a Conditional Rule with the minimum purchase set to '50' and create a Reward with Reward Type set to 'Free Product.' Then, create or select 'Tote Bag' in the Product field

Front:
You run a small business as a baker. You have a physical storefront where you offer individual loaves of bread, a lunch menu consisting of the customer's choice of sandwich and soft drink, and at-home breadmaking classes. Which of these products best fits the "Service" Product Type?

A) The individual loaves of bread, since baking bread is the service you perform as a baker
B) The at-home breadmaking classes, since you are selling an experience and not a physical good
C) The lunch menu, since you're letting customers choose items for a complete meal rather than selling them individual baked goods
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) The at-home breadmaking classes, since you are selling an experience and not a physical good

Front:
What is a valid configuration for an achievement-based commission plan?

A) 10% of all sales to a specific customer each quarter
B) $1,000 for reaching $25,000 in sales each month
C) 5% of the margin of all sales across a specific product category over the course of a year
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) $1,000 for reaching $25,000 in sales each month

Front:
How can participants in a Live Session survey receive a bonus for answering questions quickly?

A) Analyze their response time in Reporting and send them a reward manually.
B) Activate Reward quick answers in the Live Session section of the Options tab on the survey form.
C) Enable the Score by time option in the Questions tab of the survey.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Activate Reward quick answers in the Live Session section of the Options tab on the survey form.

Front:
How does a Matrix question work in an Odoo survey?

A) It requires participants to enter HTML code in their responses.
B) It displays a set of rows where participants select an answer from multiple columns.
C) It allows participants to retry the same question multiple times without penalty.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) It displays a set of rows where participants select an answer from multiple columns.

Front:
What does clicking See results > Analyze Results on a Survey do?

A) A side-by-side comparison is created for each participant.
B) The survey results are inserted into a Spreadsheet.
C) The results are compared across multiple surveys.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) The survey results are inserted into a Spreadsheet.

Front:
What happens when you click one of the colored bars at the top of a kanban stage?

A) Nothing happens.
B) Odoo filters opportunities in that stage by the color code, which represents the current activity status.
C) Odoo filters opportunities with a specific activity status across all stages (Planned, Today, Overdue).
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Odoo filters opportunities in that stage by the color code, which represents the current activity status.

Front:
What does the Probability field on an opportunity represent?

A) The likelihood that the opportunity will move to the next stage in the pipeline.
B) The likelihood of receiving a response to a quotation or offer.
C) The likelihood of successfully closing the deal with the prospect.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) The likelihood of successfully closing the deal with the prospect.

Front:
What does the Closed Date field indicate on a lead or opportunity?

A) The date the lead was marked as closed.
B) The date the opportunity was marked as won or lost.
C) The date the opportunity record was removed from the database.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) The date the opportunity was marked as won or lost.

Front:
How can you manually link an existing sales order to an existing opportunity in Odoo?

A) Through the Link Documents button on the opportunity.
B) Under the Other Info tab on the sales order.
C) By creating a new opportunity and merging it with the sales order.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Under the Other Info tab on the sales order.

Front:
Which of the following is not a Lead Enrichment option on the CRM Settings page?

A) Enrich leads on demand only.
B) Enrich leads based on customer behavior.
C) Enrich all leads automatically.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Enrich leads based on customer behavior.

Front:
How can you filter leads by company size (number of employees) when using the Generate Leads option?

A) Use the Filter on Size option.
B) Only available if you are in Developer Mode.
C) Filter based on company revenue instead of size.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Use the Filter on Size option.

Front:
How can you access an individual sales team's pipeline in Odoo?

A) Go to Sales > Teams > Pipeline.
B) Go to Configuration > Teams > Pipeline.
C) Go to Sales > Opportunities and filter by team.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Go to Sales > Teams > Pipeline.

Front:
What is the shortest interval of time at which automatic rule-based lead assignment can occur in Odoo?

A) Seconds
B) Minutes
C) Hours
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Seconds

Front:
What visual indicator shows that an opportunity has "rotted" in Odoo?

A) A red warning icon appears next to the opportunity name in the list view.
B) The opportunity's Kanban card is highlighted in red.
C) The stage header flashes to indicate a rotted opportunity.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A red warning icon appears next to the opportunity name in the list view.

Front:
How are leads from external sources, such as an email alias, automatically handled in Odoo?

A) They are automatically assigned to the sales team leader to ensure follow-up.
B) They remain unassigned until a salesperson manually claims them.
C) They are assigned randomly to any available salesperson.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) They remain unassigned until a salesperson manually claims them.

Front:
In an AI Agent prompt, what is the purpose of using /field selector?

A) To reference or update specific fields from a record directly within the prompt.
B) To create a shortcut for adding new custom fields to a model.
C) To insert predefined text snippets stored in the Knowledge app.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) To reference or update specific fields from a record directly within the prompt.

Front:
What is the purpose of the AI email prompt in Odoo email templates?

A) To decide when an email should be sent to maximize open rates.
B) To help write or enhance parts of an email message based on the template context.
C) To automatically detect recipient email addresses from contact records.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) To help write or enhance parts of an email message based on the template context.

Front:
Where can you define the response style (Creative, Balanced, Analytical) for an AI Agent?

A) On the Agent's configuration form.
B) Under General Settings > AI Preferences.
C) In each Topic definition individually.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) On the Agent's configuration form.

Front:
When you open a conversation with an AI Agent, what information does it automatically know about the record?

A) Only the record name and user's message.
B) It can access the field values of the record you're viewing, unless restricted by configuration.
C) It only knows what's stored in its Sources.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) It can access the field values of the record you're viewing, unless restricted by configuration.

Front:
How many AI Agents can you have in a single Odoo database?

A) One per installed app.
B) A maximum of five active agents per user.
C) As many as needed, there's no fixed limit.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) One per installed app.

Front:
Can you use the same mailing list contacts for BOTH email and SMS marketing campaigns?

A) No, mailing list contacts are specific to the delivery method, and are not interchangeable.
B) No, since SMS mailing list contacts do not have an email field, and email marketing lists do not have a phone number field.
C) Yes, since mailing list contacts contain both email addresses and phone numbers.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, mailing list contacts are specific to the delivery method, and are not interchangeable.

Front:
Can you create new attendees from an event registration desk kiosk once an event started?

A) No, registrants MUST register in advance.
B) Yes. On the registration desk kiosk, click Select Attendee > New, and enter all the required information.
C) No, but Odoo Events automatically creates 10 extra tickets per event, so new attendees can use one, if available
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, registrants MUST register in advance.

Front:
What are the two reports available in the 'Email Marketing' application?

A) Success Rate and Opt-Out Report.
B) Bounce Rates and Opportunities.
C) Mass Mailing Analysis and Opt-Out Report.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Success Rate and Opt-Out Report.

Front:
You've just customized a building block. Where can you reuse it?

A) You can save it and reuse it anywhere on your website.
B) You can save it and reuse it, but only on the page it was created.
C) You can save it and reuse it, but only on the homepage.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) You can save it and reuse it anywhere on your website.

Front:
Regarding the 'Search Bar' building block, can you customize what the visitor will be searching for?

A) No, the search bar is only searching for products.
B) Yes, you can choose between products, web pages, and blogs (if the related modules are installed).
C) Yes, you can choose between appointments, products, web pages, blogs, events, jobs, forums, knowledge articles, and courses (if the related modules are installed) or everything.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, the search bar is only searching for products.

Front:
You've finished designing the desktop version of your Odoo website. How can you adapt it for the mobile version using the same elements?

A) You can redesign the mobile version independently from the desktop version, and even have a different themes.
B) You can reorder elements, resize columns, and hide specific blocks for mobile without changing the desktop layout.
C) You cannot make any changes specific to the mobile version.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) You can reorder elements, resize columns, and hide specific blocks for mobile without changing the desktop layout.

Front:
In the 'Optimize SEO' tool, can you choose to fill some fields with AI?

A) Yes, but only the title and description.
B) Yes, but only keywords.
C) Yes: title, description, and keywords can be filled with AI.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Yes, but only the title and description.

Front:
Where can you set a custom internal reference for each product variant?

A) On the product form in the backend, click the Variant smart button.
B) On the product form in the backend, in the Sales tab.
C) On the product form in the backend, in the Attributes menu.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) On the product form in the backend, click the Variant smart button.

Front:
According to the screenshot below (assuming the attributes 'Fabric' and 'Legs' always generate variants), how many variants will be generated?

A) 5
B) 6
C) 2
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) 5

Front:
Are there specific ways to display product attributes over a product card on the /shop page?

A) No, they are always visible.
B) Yes, you can choose to display them or not or to display them only on Hover.
C) You can only choose to hide them or display them on scroll.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, they are always visible.

Front:
Where can you add Optional Products?

A) On the frontend of the product page with the Editor.
B) In Website > eCommerce > Products.
C) In the product backend, on the Sales tab.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) On the frontend of the product page with the Editor.

Front:
What articles feature in the 'Shared' category?

A) Articles shared to all internal users.
B) Articles shared with specific users with no default access.
C) Article accessible to the author only.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Articles shared with specific users with no default access.

Front:
What type of users can add properties?

A) Any user accessing an article
B) Portal users only
C) Users with 'Can edit' access rights
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Any user accessing an article

Front:
Which of the following commands allows for hiding and showing a block of content?

A) Index
B) Toggle list
C) Separator
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Index

Front:
How can you share a task publicly?

A) By sharing a public link to the task or project
B) By setting the task visibility to public
C) By setting the project visibility to public
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) By sharing a public link to the task or project

Front:
Which users can view a private task?

A) Only the user who created the task and users with the access right "Project Administrator"
B) All users assigned to the task and all users added as followers of the task
C) All users added as followers of the task and users with the access right "Project Administrator"
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) All users assigned to the task and all users added as followers of the task

Front:
When automatically rescheduling dependent tasks from the Gantt view, which of the following information related to assignees is not taken into account?

A) Time off
B) Working hours
C) Calendar
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Calendar

Front:
When is a milestone displayed in red?

A) When one or more of its tasks is marked as canceled
B) When the milestone's deadline is today
C) When the milestone's deadline has passed and at least one of its tasks is not marked as done or canceled
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) When the milestone's deadline has passed and at least one of its tasks is not marked as done or canceled

Front:
When creating a task from a project's Kanban view, adding "24h" to the task title will:

A) Add the text "24h" to the task's title
B) Allocate 24 hours to the task
C) Set the task deadline's to be in 24 hours
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Allocate 24 hours to the task

Front:
When creating a task from a project's Kanban view, adding "#priority" to the title will:

A) Add a "priority" tag to the task
B) Set's the task's priority to high
C) Add the text "#priority" to the task's title
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Set's the task's priority to high

Front:
The top bar does not allow you to:

A) Access records related to your projects without leaving Odoo Project
B) Automate task moves between stages
C) Add and share custom views
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Automate task moves between stages

Front:
The number of analytic accounts that can be set on a project is limited by the number of:

A) Tasks in the project
B) Analytic plans in the project
C) Kanban stages in the project
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Analytic plans in the project

Front:
What does it mean when a timesheet line is in italics?

A) It means the line has been invoiced
B) It means the line has been validated
C) It means the line is related to a project or task for which the user has not yet submitted a timesheet during the displayed period
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) It means the line has been invoiced

Front:
Which statement is true?

A) Employees cannot edit a timesheet that predates their most recent validated timesheet
B) Employees cannot edit a timesheet when a timesheet from an earlier period has not been validated yet
C) Employees cannot edit a timesheet outside their working hours
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Employees cannot edit a timesheet when a timesheet from an earlier period has not been validated yet

Front:
What happens when you enable the "Timesheet Validation" setting?

A) Timesheets must be approved by the project manager before they can be submitted
B) Employees can only record time after their timesheets are validated by their manager
C) Timesheets require validation by a supervisor before being used by the Payroll or Invoicing app
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Timesheets require validation by a supervisor before being used by the Payroll or Invoicing app

Front:
Does a time off record automatically create a timesheet?

A) Always
B) Only if the "Time Off" setting is enabled
C) Never
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Only if the "Time Off" setting is enabled

Front:
On the "All Timesheets" view, what does it mean when a duration is in orange?

A) It means the employee worked overtime on that day
B) It means the employee took time off on that day
C) It means the employee worked undertime on that day
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) It means the employee worked overtime on that day

Front:
A customer invoice with two lines, each with the same account and same 10% tax, is validated. How many items will the generated journal entry have?

A) 2 journal items
B) 3 journal items
C) 4 journal items
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) 2 journal items

Front:
What happens when you reconcile a bank transaction with a customer invoice using the bank reconciliation tool?

A) Odoo creates a new journal entry for the payment and does not change the account of any existing journal entry.
B) Odoo updates the bank transaction's journal entry to replace the suspense account with the account receivable of the invoice.
C) Odoo updates the invoice journal entry to replace the account receivable with the suspense account of the bank transaction.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Odoo creates a new journal entry for the payment and does not change the account of any existing journal entry.

Front:
How can you update exchange rates automatically?

A) By enabling the Automatic Currency Rates option in the Accounting configuration.
B) Exchange rates are automatically updated when a journal entry with a different currency is created.
C) By default, currency rates are updated daily and can be manually triggered using the developer mode.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) By enabling the Automatic Currency Rates option in the Accounting configuration.

Front:
How can you modify a posted journal entry's number?

A) You can modify a single posted journal entry's number by resetting it to draft and manually changing the number, or you can change them en masse by going into developer mode, selecting the journal entries, and selecting Resequence from the action menu.
B) Odoo will only allow users with Bookkeeper access rights for the accounting application to modify a posted journal entry's number. All other users will receive an error message.
C) You can modify a single posted journal entry's number by going into developer mode and manually changing the number, or you can change them en masse by selecting the journal entries, resetting them to draft and selecting Resequence from the action menu.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) You can modify a single posted journal entry's number by resetting it to draft and manually changing the number, or you can change them en masse by going into developer mode, selecting the journal entries, and selecting Resequence from the action menu.

Front:
What information can you define on a contact record?

A) The default payment method, preferred invoice sending method, and the invoice follow-ups.
B) The invoice follow-ups, the payment terms, and the costing method.
C) The default payment terms, default payment method, and outstanding account.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The default payment method, preferred invoice sending method, and the invoice follow-ups.

Front:
How can you create financial budgets?

A) Set up analytic plans and accounts first, then create a budget via Accounting > Accounting > Analytic Budget.
B) Go to Accounting > Reporting > Profit and Loss, then click the Budget button to display existing budgets and create a new one.
C) Go to Accounting > Reporting > Balance Sheet, and select the period. Odoo automatically creates a budget for the selected period.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Set up analytic plans and accounts first, then create a budget via Accounting > Accounting > Analytic Budget.

Front:
Can accounts belong to multiple companies?

A) Yes, but only if the companies are set as branch offices.
B) No, each account can only belong to one company.
C) Yes, by merging accounts from various companies or mapping multiple companies on an account, each with a code.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Yes, but only if the companies are set as branch offices.

Front:
Is it possible to reconcile a bank entry with a draft invoice?

A) No, draft entries cannot be reconciled with bank transactions because they're not confirmed yet.
B) Yes, draft entries can be reconciled, but only if the payment generated a journal entry that uses outstanding accounts.
C) Yes, draft invoices can be matched with bank entries for reconciliation.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, draft entries cannot be reconciled with bank transactions because they're not confirmed yet.

Front:
How can you send a payment reminder to a customer for all overdue invoices except one?

A) In the Invoices list view, search for Overdue invoices and select the desired ones. Then select Invoice Follow-ups in the Actions menu.
B) In the customer Follow-up report, enable the toggle in the No Follow-up column for the invoice you want to exclude.
C) In the Accounting tab of the customer form, click Send in the Invoice Follow-ups section and select the invoice that needs a reminder.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) In the customer Follow-up report, enable the toggle in the No Follow-up column for the invoice you want to exclude.

Front:
What do the audit features allow you to do?

A) Review working files related to selected cycles by performing various checks and balances for a specified period.
B) Both review working files and generate a customizable audit report, and control and track changes with a non-restrictive audit trail that is accessible by default to everyone.
C) Generate a customizable audit report for that period, including a table of contents, attestations, the balance sheet, a profit and loss statement, annexes, and supporting documents.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Both review working files and generate a customizable audit report, and control and track changes with a non-restrictive audit trail that is accessible by default to everyone.

Front:
In perpetual accounting, when purchasing goods to sell them, which actions generate journal entries?

A) Confirming the vendor bill and confirming the customer invoice.
B) Confirming the vendor bill, validating the delivery order, and confirming the customer invoice.
C) Validating the receipt, confirming the vendor bill, validating the delivery order, and confirming the customer invoice.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Validating the receipt, confirming the vendor bill, validating the delivery order, and confirming the customer invoice.

Front:
When you upload an Excel or CSV file and open it with Odoo Spreadsheet, what happens to the original file?

A) By default, it is deleted, but you can opt to preserve the file.
B) The original file is moved to an 'Uploaded Files' folder.
C) By default, it is preserved in the same folder unless you check 'Send source file to trash'.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) By default, it is deleted, but you can opt to preserve the file.

Front:
When a spreadsheet is converted into a dashboard, where is the original spreadsheet saved?

A) The spreadsheet remains in the Documents app but is automatically set to read-only.
B) The spreadsheet is saved in a special Dashboard assets folder, in the Documents app.
C) The spreadsheet is deleted from the Documents app and can only be accessed via the Dashboards app.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The spreadsheet remains in the Documents app but is automatically set to read-only.

Front:
In a multi-company database with Company A, Company B, and Company C, how can you ensure only users from Company A and Company B can access a new dashboard you create?

A) In the dashboard configuration, set which companies' users can access the dashboard.
B) You need to duplicate the dashboard and assign each copy to a single company.
C) This is not possible; any dashboard is visible to all companies present in the database.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) In the dashboard configuration, set which companies' users can access the dashboard.

Front:
How would you set up a mechanism where the amount of time off an employee gets depends on their number of days worked?

A) You create a new Time Off type that does not require any approvals.
B) You create a new Allocation and set the Allocation Type to "Accrual Allocation"
C) You create a new Time Off type that does not permit Extra Day Requests
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) You create a new Allocation and set the Allocation Type to "Accrual Allocation"

Front:
In the Employees app, what does the History smart button do?

A) Allows you to revert to any previous contract
B) It shows all versions of the Employee record, and allows you to view past records
C) Shows all payslips for the employee, grouped by job title and salary
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Allows you to revert to any previous contract

Front:
How do you automatically send an email asking an applicant to schedule an interview in the Recruitment app?

A) Edit the corresponding stage in the pipeline, and select the email template 'Recruitment: Schedule interview'.
B) Select the email template 'Recruitment: Schedule Interview' in the Configuration page for the job position.
C) The Recruitment app automatically sends the 'Recruitment: Schedule Interview' email template when the candidate moves to the Qualified stage; there is no further configuration needed
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Edit the corresponding stage in the pipeline, and select the email template 'Recruitment: Schedule interview'.

Front:
How can a user with the required rights change an Employee's presence in the database from Present to Absent?

A) In the Attendances app dashboard, click on the employee attendance record, and select Absent
B) In the Employees app dashboard, click Presence Icon > Absent
C) On the Employee record, click Actions > Presence Control > Set Absent
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) In the Employees app dashboard, click Presence Icon > Absent

Front:
How can you determine if an employee is out of the office, taking a sick day?

A) A red stethoscope icon appears on their employee profile
B) An orange airplane appears on their employee profile.
C) A gray 'Out Of Office' banner appears on their employee profile.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A red stethoscope icon appears on their employee profile

Front:
What happens to an order when you split a bill?

A) A sub-order is created.
B) The bill is printed.
C) Nothing, you proceed with the same order.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A sub-order is created.

Front:
If no payment method is selected, what is the default one in the register?

A) Cash.
B) Card.
C) Customer account.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Cash.

Front:
If a product set for a late ship is not available, what should you do?

A) Cancel the order until more units are ordered.
B) Update the unit quantity.
C) Refund the customer.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Cancel the order until more units are ordered.

Front:
After the buyer confirms a purchase order, how does the seller create a corresponding sales order using EDI?

A) The buyer's database automatically pushes the PO into the seller's sales orders list
B) The seller downloads the XML from the buyer's portal and uploads it in their Sales app
C) In the email the seller receives, the seller clicks the "Download" button and uploads the downloaded PDF to the Sales dashboard
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The buyer's database automatically pushes the PO into the seller's sales orders list

Front:
While using 3-way matching, for products with Invoicing Policy = Received quantities, you upload a vendor bill for the full PO before any receipt. How is it treated?

A) The bill is created, but "Should Be Paid?" = No (fails 3-way match until receipt)
B) Bill upload is blocked until at least one receipt is validated
C) The bill uploads and is automatically marked payable in full regardless of receipts
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The bill is created, but "Should Be Paid?" = No (fails 3-way match until receipt)

Front:
If you have a product with several vendors assigned to it, which one will be used when an RFQ is automatically generated?

A) The first vendor on the list matching the minimum quantity condition
B) The vendor with the shortest delivery lead time
C) The vendor with the cheapest price
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The first vendor on the list matching the minimum quantity condition

Front:
Using the 'Average Cost' costing method, will the cost in the product form change when you receive products?

A) Yes
B) Yes, but only if the vendor bill arrives at the same time as the product
C) No
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Yes

Front:
When you purchase new products, how is the Expected Arrival date computed on new PO lines?

A) Order Date - Vendor Lead Time - Company Security Days
B) Order Date + Vendor Lead Time
C) Order Date + Vendor Lead Time + Company Security Days
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Order Date + Vendor Lead Time

Front:
When creating a new request for quotation (RFQ), are you able to link it to an existing RFQ as an alternative?

A) No, alternative RFQs must be created from the 'Alternatives' tab of an existing, pre-populated RFQ with a listed vendor and products
B) No, Odoo does not allow multiple RFQs to be linked to each other unless the same vendor is listed on each
C) Yes, by clicking 'Link to Existing RfQ', under the 'Alternatives' tab on a new request for quotation
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) No, alternative RFQs must be created from the 'Alternatives' tab of an existing, pre-populated RFQ with a listed vendor and products

Front:
When the '3-way matching' feature is activated, how will you know which vendor bills are ready to be paid for received quantities?

A) You won't. The '3-way matching' feature only works when the bill control policy is set to 'On ordered quantities'
B) The 'Should Be Paid' field will read 'Yes', under the 'Other Info' tab on the vendor bill
C) When the vendor bill's status changes from 'In Payment' to 'Paid'
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) You won't. The '3-way matching' feature only works when the bill control policy is set to 'On ordered quantities'

Front:
You set "Based On" to Last 7 days and "Replenish for" to 15 days. Odoo suggests quantities for several products. What data is Odoo using to generate these suggestions?

A) It only considers confirmed purchase orders in the last 7 days to compute daily demand, then multiplies by 15
B) It averages the price of the product over the last 7 days to compare to what you're paying for the next 15 days to make sure your vendors aren't ripping you off
C) It looks at quantities delivered over the past 7 days to compute daily demand, then multiplies by 15 and subtracts on-hand stock
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) It looks at quantities delivered over the past 7 days to compute daily demand, then multiplies by 15 and subtracts on-hand stock

Front:
You're reviewing the Forecasted report for a product that's running low. The "Time to Replenish" field shows 5 days. What does this tell you?

A) You have 5 days to decide to replenish before your stock runs into critically low levels
B) The product can't be replenished sooner than 5 days because the vendor is out
C) If you order today, the product would arrive in 5 days, based on today's date and configured lead times
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) You have 5 days to decide to replenish before your stock runs into critically low levels

Front:
Your warehouse is set up to deliver in three steps: pick, pack, and ship. In the 'Pick' step, you are supposed to pick 10 chairs and 5 desks, but you accidentally pick 15 chairs and 2 desks. You select 'No Backorder' during the process. What will be the result in the 'Pack' step?

A) 15 chairs, 2 desks
B) 10 chairs and 5 desks
C) 10 chairs, 2 desks
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) 15 chairs, 2 desks

Front:
When performing an inventory adjustment that increases a product's stock from 0 to 5 units, what are the 'Location Types' of the locations involved in the resulting stock move?

A) A move from an 'Internal Location' to an 'Inventory Adjustment' location
B) A move from an 'Inventory Loss' location to an 'Internal Location'
C) A move between two 'Internal Locations'
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A move from an 'Internal Location' to an 'Inventory Adjustment' location

Front:
Which of the following does NOT create stock moves?

A) Dragging serial or lot numbers between locations in the Locations (Kanban) view
B) Using the Relocate button on the Inventory Adjustments dashboard
C) Going to Inventory > Reporting > Moves History page and clicking New
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Dragging serial or lot numbers between locations in the Locations (Kanban) view

Front:
If a product has been reserved for sales orders and you perform an 'Inventory Adjustment' to set the on-hand quantity to 0, what will happen to the forecasted quantity of that product?

A) The forecasted quantity is updated to 0
B) There's no change to the forecasted quantity
C) The forecasted quantity becomes negative, and the product is marked as "Not Available" on any current delivery orders
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The forecasted quantity is updated to 0

Front:
When you update on-hand quantities from 5 units to 4 for a specific product, what stock moves are created?

A) A move of 4 units from an 'Internal Location' to an 'Inventory Loss' location
B) A move of 1 unit from an 'Internal Location' to an 'Inventory Loss' location
C) A move of 1 unit from an 'Inventory Loss' location to an 'Internal Location'
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A move of 4 units from an 'Internal Location' to an 'Inventory Loss' location

Front:
You're configuring a packaging called "Pack of 6" to sell six soda bottles together. Soda's base unit of measure is units. You set the Package Type to Carton (representing the cardboard six-pack holder). On a delivery order for 6 units of soda and click "Put in Pack", what effect does this configuration have?

A) Create a new package with the Package Type "Carton", with all 6 sodas inside
B) Create a new package with the Package Type "Carton", with all 6 sodas inside, but the unit is converted to 1 "Pack of 6" on the delivery order
C) Creates one package containing all 6 sodas, but no Package Type is set, because it's not a thing
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Create a new package with the Package Type "Carton", with all 6 sodas inside

Front:
Where is the "Count Entire Locations" Barcode feature configured?

A) In Inventory > Configuration > Settings, under the Barcode section, enable the "Count Entire Locations" feature
B) Go to the Locations configuration page and enable the "Count Entire Locations" feature
C) In the Barcode app, click "Count inventory", click the gear icon (settings) menu, and enable "Count Entire Locations"
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) In Inventory > Configuration > Settings, under the Barcode section, enable the "Count Entire Locations" feature

Front:
What does the 'i' button on the Replenishment dashboard NOT do?

A) Display the forecasted arrival date of the product
B) Triggers the reordering rule
C) Display lead times
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Display the forecasted arrival date of the product

Front:
I want to configure a specific route in my warehouse for FedEx, but it needs to be different than the route we use for DHL. I can do this by:

A) Going to Inventory > Configuration > Shipping Methods and choosing a routes for the Routes field.
B) Click the "Quality Checks" button available on transfers configured with a quality control point
C) Create a custom route for the shipping method and setting it in the Routes field in Inventory > Configuration > Delivery Methods
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Going to Inventory > Configuration > Shipping Methods and choosing a routes for the Routes field.

Front:
You want to trigger quality checks when products arrive from vendors. How should you configure this?

A) Create a quality control point on the "Receipt" operation type
B) Create a control point on the "Vendor Reception" operation type
C) Create a quality check for each specific vendor
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Create a quality control point on the "Receipt" operation type

Front:
Your MPS shows a forecasted demand of 110 units for a product with a BoM Batch Size of 40. What happens when you click "Order"?

A) 3 MOs are created, with 40 units in two MOs, and 30 units in the third MO
B) 3 MOs are created, 40 units each
C) 4 MOs with 30 each
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) 3 MOs are created, with 40 units in two MOs, and 30 units in the third MO

Front:
A MO produces 5 products tracked by serial numbers. How do you generate serial numbers for all finished products?

A) Enable the "Custom Lot/Serial" feature for the product, then click "Generate Serial". This creates five serial numbers in the Lot/Serial Number field
B) It's not possible to have more than one serial number in the "Lot/Serial Number" field, so Odoo creates backorders for the remaining four unassigned serial numbers
C) You must manually create five separate Manufacturing Orders, each for quantity 1, so that Odoo assigns a serial number to each finished product individually
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Enable the "Custom Lot/Serial" feature for the product, then click "Generate Serial". This creates five serial numbers in the Lot/Serial Number field

Front:
What do the additional row options Actual Demand Y-1 and Actual Demand Y-2 refer to in the Master Production Schedule (MPS)?

A) The quantity of products sold at this time last year and two years ago, respectively
B) The quantity of products delivered to customer locations at the same time last year and two years ago, respectively
C) The demand forecast input in the MPS this time last year and two years ago respectively
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The quantity of products sold at this time last year and two years ago, respectively

Front:
When alternative work centers are configured, which work center will Odoo select for work orders?

A) The work center with the highest capacity
B) The work center with the lowest cost per hour
C) The work center that will finish the task the soonest
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) The work center that will finish the task the soonest

Front:
You've configured your manufacturing process to happen in two steps: pick components, and then manufacture. You decide to produce more, what happens with the pre-production picking?

A) Nothing at first, and once you confirm the picking, a backorder is created to make up the missing quantities
B) The component quantities are updated to reflect the new quantities needed
C) A warning is raised to reflect that the original quantity does not fulfill the updated demand. You have to click "Update Quantity"
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Nothing at first, and once you confirm the picking, a backorder is created to make up the missing quantities

Front:
What must happen in order to mark a subcontracted order as complete?

A) The subcontractor must validate component consumption from the subcontracting portal
B) The user must validate the receipt of the product from the subcontractor
C) The finished product must be shipped
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The subcontractor must validate component consumption from the subcontracting portal

Front:
Which app is the Shop Floor module installed alongside?

A) Accounting
B) Manufacturing
C) Maintenance
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Accounting

Front:
Which of the following is NOT shown on the card for an MO on the Shop Floor dashboard?

A) The estimated time to complete the MO
B) The MO number
C) The product being manufactured
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The estimated time to complete the MO

Front:
What happens when no employees are listed in the 'Allowed Employees' field on a work center form?

A) No employee is allowed to operate the work center
B) It is not possible to leave the 'Allowed Employees' field blank
C) Any employee is allowed to operate the work center
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Any employee is allowed to operate the work center

Front:
Where do you find the cost of processing a specific work order?

A) Manufacturing app -> Operations -> Manufacturing Orders -> select MO -> Overview -> Operations section
B) Manufacturing app -> Operations -> Manufacturing Orders -> select MO -> Work Orders tab
C) Manufacturing app -> Operations -> Work Orders -> select work order
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Manufacturing app -> Operations -> Manufacturing Orders -> select MO -> Overview -> Operations section

Front:
What does it mean when a work center is operating at "reduced speed"?

A) The work center is operating more slowly than usual
B) The work center does not have enough employees staffing it
C) The work center is processing a work order that has exceeded its expected duration
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) The work center is operating more slowly than usual

Front:
Which relational field type must exist for a One2Many field to function?

A) Related Field.
B) Many2Many.
C) Many2One.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Many2One.

Front:
Which property should you use on a field if you want to display an example of how the field should be completed (e.g., 'Enter up to 50 characters')?

A) Placeholder.
B) Help Tooltip.
C) Default Value.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Placeholder.

Front:
A dynamic table in a report is based on a relational field. Which type(s) of relational fields can be used for this purpose?

A) Many2One only.
B) Related Fields only.
C) One2Many or Many2Many.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) One2Many or Many2Many.

Front:
When setting up an approval step on a button, which option, if enabled, prevents a user who approves one step from approving any other step on the same record?

A) Exclusive Approval.
B) Approval Order.
C) Sequential Approval.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Exclusive Approval.

Front:
How can you ensure a customer is automatically added as a follower when project changed state to 'In Progress'?

A) Use the 'Add Followers' action with the type 'Dynamic Followers', then select the appropriate partner field.
B) Use the 'Create Activity' action and select the customer's email field.
C) Use the 'Send Email' action and set the action to 'Message'.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Use the 'Add Followers' action with the type 'Dynamic Followers', then select the appropriate partner field.

Front:
When updating a record using AI, how can you insert dynamic values in prompts?

A) Right-click, select 'Insert Dynamic Placeholder', then select the field.
B) Type a field's technical name enclosed in curly brackets, e.g., {customer_id}.
C) Type '/' then click 'Field selector' and select the field.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Right-click, select 'Insert Dynamic Placeholder', then select the field.

Front:
What are the two types of contacts in Odoo?

A) Person and Company.
B) Person and Joint.
C) Company and Not-for-Profit.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Person and Company.

Front:
What does it mean when a record is archived in Odoo?

A) Records cannot be archived for traceability purposes.
B) When a record is archived in Odoo, it is hidden from regular view, and no longer active.
C) When a record is archived, nobody can ever modify it, it's frozen forever.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) When a record is archived in Odoo, it is hidden from regular view, and no longer active.

Front:
Inside a record, how do you schedule an activity?

A) Click the "Activity" button at the top of the chatter and choose the activity type, due date, assignee, and log a note.
B) Click the "New Activity" option in the chatter menu and select the activity type, responsible user, and deadline.
C) Open the Activities panel from the record header and use "Add Activity" to define the activity details.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Click the "Activity" button at the top of the chatter and choose the activity type, due date, assignee, and log a note.

Front:
What does activating Superuser mode do?

A) It allows the user to impersonate any other user.
B) It allows the user to bypass record rules and access rights.
C) It provides the user with temporary Administration Access Rights.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) It allows the user to impersonate any other user.

Front:
What type of commission plan would you use to reward sales people for hitting a quarterly fixed, predefined sales goal?

A) A target-based commission plan
B) An achievement-based commission plan
C) Either a target or achievement-based commission plan
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A target-based commission plan

Front:
If you would like to group specific sales order lines together to generate subtotals, what feature would you use on the quotation/sales order?

A) Product categories
B) Sequences
C) Sections
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Sections

Front:
Which of the following actions can customers NOT perform in the customer portal?

A) Manage pricelists for their most frequently purchased products
B) Add funds to their eWallet
C) Submit partial payments and down payments for invoices (if the payment terms allow)
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Manage pricelists for their most frequently purchased products

Front:
What does the 'Customer Lead Time' field on a product form represent?

A) The computed order date based on the quotation date
B) The number of days, promised to the customer, between the confirmation of the sales order and the delivery
C) Confirmation that the Terms & Conditions will be displayed on the quotation
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) The number of days, promised to the customer, between the confirmation of the sales order and the delivery

Front:
You want to create a "Buy 10 Sandwiches, Get 1 Free" offer to encourage repeat customers. Which Setting must be activated in the Sales app to allow this?

A) Discounts, since the free sandwich is technically a normal sandwich sold at a 100% discount
B) Pricelists, since you need to create a custom Pricelist with the "BOGO" setting activated
C) Promotions, Loyalty & Gift Card, since you're creating a loyalty program
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Discounts, since the free sandwich is technically a normal sandwich sold at a 100% discount

Front:
When generating Gift Cards, they can be generated for...

A) Anonymous Customer
B) Selected Customers
C) Both
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Both

Front:
Which of the following is NOT a 'Variant Creation' option while creating product attributes?

A) Instantly
B) Formula-based
C) Dynamically
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Formula-based

Front:
How do you configure an upsell product to appear on the bottom of another product page in your eCommerce store?

A) In the 'Sales' tab of your eCommerce product, enter the upsell product in the 'Alternative Products' field
B) In your eCommerce website, drag and drop the product from the Odoo product page (open on a separate tab)
C) There is no way to add an upsell product to the bottom a product page in the eCommerce store.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) In the 'Sales' tab of your eCommerce product, enter the upsell product in the 'Alternative Products' field

Front:
When a new survey is being created, which of the following is NOT an available survey type option?

A) Recruitment
B) Questionnaire
C) Assesment
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Recruitment

Front:
In the 'Options' tab of a survey form, what are the 'Display Progress as' options?

A) 'Percentage left' and 'Progress bar'.
B) 'Percentage left' and 'Number'.
C) 'Progress bar' and 'Number'.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) 'Progress bar' and 'Number'.

Front:
Which of the following options is not available in a Live Session?

A) Survey time limit.
B) Scoring without Answers.
C) Matrix Questions.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Survey time limit.

Front:
How can Odoo detect that 2 leads are duplicates and can be merged (not similar leads)?

A) They share the same email address
B) They share the same opportunity name
C) They have the exact same tags
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) They share the same email address

Front:
What does converting a lead mean?

A) Creating a lead from a contact card.
B) Closing a deal.
C) Transforming a lead into an opportunity.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Transforming a lead into an opportunity.

Front:
What does the Opportunities smart button display on a company's contact record in Odoo?

A) All opportunities related to the company and its contacts.
B) Only opportunities that have been won.
C) Only opportunities that have scheduled activities.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) All opportunities related to the company and its contacts.

Front:
Who can access Reporting in the CRM app?

A) Only database administrators.
B) Only managers.
C) All CRM users.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) All CRM users.

Front:
When is it useful to create a new property field on an opportunity?

A) When your sales team needs to track a specific piece of information.
B) When a sales manager notices an opportunity has an overdue activity.
C) When a salesperson wants to impress a client.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) When your sales team needs to track a specific piece of information.

Front:
What does an orange activity icon on an opportunity card in Kanban view indicate?

A) The activity is due soon.
B) The activity is overdue.
C) The activity is due today.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) The activity is due today.

Front:
Which of the following can be used as Sources for an AI Agent?

A) Only text fields and record notes.
B) Uploaded files, Knowledge articles, docs from the Documents app, and website links.
C) Knowledge articles and docs from the Documents app only.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Uploaded files, Knowledge articles, docs from the Documents app, and website links.

Front:
What is the purpose of AI Tools in Odoo's AI framework?

A) To provide extra data sources for the agent to read from.
B) To limit the agent's output to predefined templates.
C) To extend the AI Agent's capabilities beyond text generation, allowing it to perform defined actions or functions.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) To extend the AI Agent's capabilities beyond text generation, allowing it to perform defined actions or functions.

Front:
You want to ask an AI Agent how many leads are currently assigned to a specific salesperson. Which Topic must be assigned to the agent for it to answer that question?

A) Information Reporting.
B) Information Retrieval.
C) Lead Assessment.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Information Reporting.

Front:
On a mailing form, what's the purpose of this button next to the 'Subject' line?

A) To include a link to a satisfaction survey at the bottom of the communication.
B) To add the company's logo to the top of the communication.
C) To insert dynamic values in the subject line.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) To insert dynamic values in the subject line.

Front:
What is an A/B test?

A) Sending different versions of a marketing email to a small group of recipients in a mailing list. The version that performs the best is then sent to the remaining contacts in the mailing list.
B) Sending a selection of emails to a random portion of contacts in the database, at regular intervals, with no end date.
C) Sending the same email to two different mailing lists, so the mailing list with the fewest open rates is archived.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Sending different versions of a marketing email to a small group of recipients in a mailing list. The version that performs the best is then sent to the remaining contacts in the mailing list.

Front:
In SMS Marketing, under the 'A/B Tests' tab on a message form, which metric is available for selecting the winning email?

A) Highest Click Rate
B) Forwards
C) Bounces
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Highest Click Rate

Front:
How can you add the 'customizable cookie bar' for your website visitors?

A) Going to the 'Style' tab in the website editor and enable it.
B) By enabling the feature in the website settings.
C) By activating developer mode and enabling it in the website properties.

Front:
You added the 'Newsletter popup' on your website, and you want to edit it. How can you find it?

A) By going into 'Edit' mode on your website and waiting a few seconds for the pop-up to appear.
B) By clicking on 'Newsletter Popup' in the 'Invisible Elements' section at the bottom of the website editor.

Front:
On which device can you decide to hide certain content blocks when editing your website?

A) Desktop
B) Desktop and mobile
C) Desktop, mobile, and tablet
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Desktop and mobile

Front:
Is it possible to add a hyperlink to an image on your website?

A) Yes, by adding a URL to the media in the website editor.
B) Yes, by activating the developer mode and going to Settings > Technical > Database Structure > Hyperlinks.
C) You cannot link an image to a URL on your website.

Front:
Which Odoo feature lets you show a similar product to a customer browsing a product page?

A) Alternative products
B) Accessory products
C) Optional products
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) Alternative products

Front:
You want to show your customers additional products they may be interested in upon checkout, which feature can you use?

A) Alternative products.
B) Optional products.
C) Accessory products.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) Optional products.

Front:
On the frontend, where can you display a 'Sale' Badge or Ribbon on a product?

A) On the /shop/[productName-id] page, in the Style tab only.
B) On the /shop page, in the Style tab only.
C) Both options are valid.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Both options are valid.

Front:
What can you add to a product to highlight it in your catalog and/or on the product page?

A) A ribbon.
B) A badge.
C) A ribbon or a badge.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: A) A ribbon.

Front:
Who can edit an article in the Workspace?

A) Any contributor with 'Can read' access.
B) The author only.
C) Everyone, as long as it's in the default company access.
Back: ✅ Jawaban: B) The author only.

Front:
What happens if you lock an article in the Workspace?

A) You cannot access the article.
B) You can only read the article.
C) You can still edit it, even if you're not the author.

Front:
Can you copy the link of one specific header?

A) Yes, any header can be copied.
B) No, you can only copy the article's link.
C) Yes, but you can only copy the title.

Front:
When can Odoo send an automatic task rating request to a customer?

A) Only when a task reaches a specific stage
B) Only on a periodic basis (e.g., every month)
C) Both when a task reaches a specific stage or on a periodic basis
Back: ✅ Jawaban: C) Both when a task reaches a specific stage or on a periodic basis

Front:
Which of the following project visibility options does not exist?

Front:
